subject.title: perf(state): cap the per-agent SQLite handle cache with LRU eviction

question: Should the plugin SDK permanently expose `listSessionEntries({ readOnly: true })`, or should fleet-introspection behavior remain behind an internal/core-only seam?
rationale: This is a new plugin-facing lifecycle contract whose read-only behavior deliberately avoids creation, registration, and migration; reviewers cannot safely choose its permanent compatibility boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep a documented SDK read-only mode
options.body: Approve the public mode after defining its missing-database, lock, schema, and compatibility behavior and adding focused contract coverage.

options.title: Keep read-only access internal
options.body: Use an internal/core seam for health, usage, and bundled-plugin detection so external plugin API surface does not expand.

recommendation.title: Keep read-only access internal
recommendation.body: Use an internal/core seam for health, usage, and bundled-plugin detection so external plugin API surface does not expand.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch owns the proposed session-store API boundary and the related lifecycle changes.
